luiskr.com / core/firebase / onAuthChange

function onAuthChange(callback): Promise<Unsubscribe>;

Defined in: core/firebase.ts:156

Subscribes to auth state after lazily loading firebase/auth. First resolves a pending redirect sign-in (the signInWithGoogle popup fallback) so the callback fires with the fresh session on return — a failed redirect logs the error and falls through to the normal listener.

Parameters

callback

(_user) => void

Invoked with the User (or null on sign-out) on every auth transition.

Returns

Promise<Unsubscribe>

the SDK's unsubscribe function
